edge_record.provenance: ast | regex | doc | ontology | filesystem | name

CALLS.description: A call. confidence 1.0 exact or observed, 0.9 self/super, 0.8 typed, 0.6-0.7 by unique name in Rust, Dart, Kotlin, Java.

CITES.description: Code that names a FIX-### entry.

COMPOSED_OF.description: A Non-Comp's axis and dimension; a manifold entry's Non-Comp and base axis.

CONTAINS.description: Structural ownership: repo > package > module or source file > class > method.

DOCUMENTS.description: A document that names this code, store, bus slot or organ.

EMITS.description: Sends an event, frame or message to an endpoint.

EXPRESSES.description: Code that carries an Aurora concept. provenance ast (literals) or name (identifiers).

FEEDS.description: Information flow: a value produced by the source lands in the target. attrs: via (functions where the hand-off happens), roles (assign, argument, receiver, return, store_write, payload).

GOVERNS.description: A registry entry that names this code or store.

HANDLES.description: Receives calls arriving at an endpoint.

IMPLEMENTED_BY.description: The class of the object registered in the slot.

IMPORTS.description: An import. attrs: names (imported symbols), lazy (inside a function).

INHERITS.description: A base class, implemented trait or interface. attrs: names (base name when external).

INVOKES.description: Calls across a runtime or language boundary.

MEMBER_OF.description: A module's part in a responsibility. attrs: method (declared_layer, organ, name_pattern, path).

OVERRIDES.description: A method that redefines a method of a base class.

PART_OF.description: A stage that belongs to a sequence; a subsystem that sits in a layer.

PASSES_CALLBACK.description: Hands a function reference to other code to call later. attrs: to (receiving callee), params.

PERSISTS_TO.description: A class whose methods write this store (derived from WRITES).

PRECEDES.description: Canonical order: L0 > L8, re-entry stages, observer levels.

READS.description: Reads a field, persisted file, environment variable, bus slot or pipeline signal.

REFERENCES.description: Names a persisted file without a read or write visible in the same statement.

REGISTERS.description: Places an object into a systems slot.

ROUTES_TO.description: Where an endpoint delivers the work: the function that runs on the far side.

RUNS.description: A shell script, workflow or service unit launching a module or a script.

SPAWNS.description: Starts work that runs later or elsewhere. attrs: mechanisms (thread, timer, executor, task, call_later, atexit, signal, android_service).

SUBSCRIBES.description: Listens for events, frames or messages at an endpoint.

TESTS.description: A test module importing the module under test.

USES_ORGAN.description: Reads a systems slot to use the organ in it.

WRITES.description: Writes or mutates a field, persisted file, environment variable, bus slot or pipeline signal.

BusChannel.description: A systems["_key"] bus slot: signals passed between organs.

Class.description: A class, struct, enum, trait or object definition. language: python, rust, dart, kotlin, java.

Concept.description: A named Aurora subsystem or a stage of a canonical sequence.

Constant.description: An UPPER_CASE module- or class-level assignment.

ConstraintAxis.description: One of the five canonical constraint axes X, T, N, B, A.

DoctrineRule.description: A FIX-### entry of the known fixes registry.

Document.description: A Markdown document in the repo.

Endpoint.description: A point where one runtime or language hands work to another. protocol: methodchannel, eventchannel, chaquopy, http, frame, android_intent.

EnvVar.description: An environment variable the code reads or sets.

ExternalDependency.description: A top-level import outside the repo. ecosystem: stdlib, builtins, third_party.

Field.description: A state holder: an instance or class attribute, or module-level state that functions change. kind: instance, class, module_state.

Function.description: A function or method in any analysed language. kind: function, method, staticmethod, classmethod, property, nested.

IStatePair.description: One of the five I-State polarity pairs.

Layer.description: An architectural layer, L0-L8, or the Orchestrator.

ManifoldEntry.description: One file in the constraint manifold directory.

Module.description: A Python source file. role: core, internal, package_init, test, script, tool, app.

NonComp.description: One of the 25 Non-Comps (axis x dimension).

NonCompDimension.description: One of the five Non-Comp representational dimensions.

Organ.description: A systems["key"] slot holding a live subsystem object.

Signal.description: A key of a turn's pipeline state (pipeline_state["key"]).

SourceFile.description: A non-Python source file (Rust, Dart, Kotlin, Java, shell, workflow, web).

StateStore.description: A persisted file the code reads or writes, named relative to the state dir.

Subsystem.description: A responsibility: a layer, a named Aurora subsystem or an organ's implementation. basis says whether it is declared or inferred.
